plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Psychology, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/psychology-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Psychology Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines footnote 3 on this page ('See approved Foreign Language list for the AA Degree'); grid rows shown only as footnote 4 or 5 with units, and blank rows, do not name a specific course and are not defined on this page — modeled as choice slots with the catalog's footnote number preserved in choice_note where present; see advisor. Designed as a university transfer program substantially meeting the first two years of the BA in Psychology at UNR. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
